QuestInfo.name: Report to Cartalion
QuestInfo.0: There are some priests of Pantheon planning some bad things. Wouldn't it be a good idea to let #p3000000# know about this incident?
QuestInfo.1: Report to #p3000000# at the Community Hall of Pantheon about the Nefarious Priests.
QuestInfo.2: #p3000000# wants to investigate the Nefarious Priests further, to ensure they do not attack other sanctums.

0.0: I'm sure that guy was one of the Nefarious Priests that I saw at the East Sanctum. I don't have any evidence...but do heroes really need evidence? Should I tell #p3000000# about this?

yes.0: Yeah, I better tell him. Better to smash your foes before they can work their evil. All right, #p3000000#! I'm coming!

no.0: Ehh...I guess I should find something to back this up. But is there anything?

1.0: What's going on?\r\n#L0##bSo, there were these Nefarious Priests...#l\n#k
1.1: Huh? You saw the Nefarious Priests in the rear of Pantheon? Huh... I just heard the same thing from Angelic Buster.\r\n

yes.0: These are the same guys that attacked the East Sanctum? With multiple sightings, we must prepare for the worst. Right, I'm no longer your superior. You don't need to report to me. Trust in your feelings, and defend our people.

npc.0: #p3000000# is at #m400000000#, if I recall. He must be made aware!
